name: ui11_24_effects_end_messages_need_a_paint
description: Conformance test 24 [game; this vector is the window-side consequence of effects.md EF2]. The draw pass runs because the city view paints (7): cGZWinGen::GZPaint is slot 88 and the renderer's passes are DrawStaticView / DrawDynamicView. A city view that is never painted never reaches cSC4EffectsManager::DeactivateUnusedVisualEffects (0x005922A0), so no effect end message is posted. A headless run has to synthesise the sweep exactly as EF2 says.
